cog_menu.description:

If the incremental search is getting a very low hit-rate (like 5 out of 750,000 pairs), it is usually faster for the database to just run the file searches and then cross-reference.

In complicated edge cases, this optimisation has very bad performance, so if you see a block or two of work and then your search halts for 30+ seconds, you can turn it off here.
